# cycle_integration (Resource)

Manages a Cycle hub integration (`/v1/integrations`). Integrations connect a vendor (billing, image builders, infrastructure providers, object storage, or TLS certificate generation) to the hub. `vendor` is immutable. Authentication and `extra` values are write-sensitive: later reads preserve state when the API omits secrets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An AWS integration. Auth and extra are write-sensitive: later reads
# preserve state when the Cycle API omits secrets.
resource "cycle_integration" "aws" {
  name   = "AWS Production"
  vendor = "aws"

  # Optional; auto-generated from the name if omitted.
  identifier = "aws-production"

  auth = {
    api_key = "example-access-key"
    secret  = "example-secret-key"
    region  = "us-east-1"
  }

  extra = {
    account_id = "123456789012"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A user-defined name for the integration.
- `vendor` (String) The vendor this integration is associated with (e.g. `aws`). Changing this forces a new integration to be created.

### Optional

- `auth` (Attributes) Vendor-specific authentication credentials. These values are write-sensitive; later reads preserve state when the API omits them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `extra` (Map of String, Sensitive) Additional vendor-specific key-value pairs. Write-sensitive; later reads preserve state when the API omits this map.
- `identifier` (String) A human-readable slugged identifier for the integration. Automatically generated from the name if not provided.

### Read-Only

- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this integration belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the integration.
- `state` (String) The current state of the integration (e.g. `live`).

<a id="nestedatt--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth`

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key for accessing the integration.
- `base64_config` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded configuration for the integration.
- `client_id` (String, Sensitive) Client ID for the integration.
- `key_id` (String, Sensitive) Key ID for accessing the integration.
- `namespace` (String, Sensitive) The namespace associated with the integration.
- `region` (String, Sensitive) The region associated with the integration.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret for accessing the integration.
- `subscription_id` (String, Sensitive) Subscription ID for the integration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Integrations are imported using their ID.
terraform import cycle_integration.aws 651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21
```
